verdict.rationale: A maintainer confirmed that the LiteLLM proxy supports function-calling the same way as the openai-python SDK. The docs say every response follows the OpenAI Chat Completions format regardless of provider. Together these imply a consistent tool-calling schema, but no first-party docs page shows tool-call translation across providers. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of tool/function-call support and schema mapping per provider, a list of which providers support tools, and hands-on corroboration of cross-provider tool calls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can make tool and function calls across different providers with a consistent schema

citations.quote: LiteLLM maintainer confirmed proxy supports streaming and function-calling in the same way as the openai-python SDK
Every response follows the OpenAI Chat Completions format, regardless of provider.
Call any provider using the same completion() interface, with no API to re-learn for each one
